name: Spyros
title: Night Drop
description: Curly-crop trapper in a black crew tee. Super drops the bass, stacks the chain, and rides the beat until the round ends.
source_description: Male fighter, athletic build, tight curly dark crop, thick brows, olive-tan skin, black crew t-shirt, dark pants, gold chain, no sunglasses, standing stance.
special_desc: A forward burst that cuts the hook.
ultimate_desc: Bass drop quake. Stacks the chain. ATK stays up while the beat rides.
